verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Foreloop exposing its own MCP server endpoint (/api/app/public/v1/mcp) so that external MCP clients (agents) can call into it — this is the reverse of the story, which asks whether the user can plug external MCP servers into Foreloop so it can use their tools. No evidence shows Foreloop acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools.
